LESSON: KUANDIKA 3.3.1 KUANDIKA KWA TARAKILISHI

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: MAPAMBO Mada Mada Ndogo Matokeo Maalumu Yanayotarajiwa Shughuli za Ujifunzaji Zi
Topic 3.3: Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo ni somo la kusoma: Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi. Soma maelezo, fuata mifano iliyofanyiwa kazi, kisha fanya mazoezi.

SEHEMU 2: MALENGO

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. explain what Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi means in simple pupil language
2. give 3 correct examples of Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi from Kenya
3. practise Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi in clear steps
4. apply Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi in one real-life situation this week

SEHEMU 3: SOMO (MAELEZO NA MIFANO)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: KUANDIKA 3.3.1 KUANDIKA KWA TARAKILISHI
Subject: KISWAHILI · Grade: Grade 5
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi helps you succeed in KISWAHILI. You will understand it, practise it, and use it nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

KEY FACTS: KUANDIKA 3.3.1 KUANDIKA KWA TARAKILISHI
Study Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Explain what Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi means in simple pupil language

What this means
In this part you learn to explain what Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi means in simple pupil language. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain what Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi means in simple pupil language.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kusoma: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain what Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi means in simple pupil language. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Give 3 correct examples of Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi from Kenya

What this means
In this part you learn to give 3 correct examples of Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi from Kenya. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: give 3 correct examples of Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi from Kenya.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kuzungumza: Zungumza na rafiki kwa dakika 1 kuhusu Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can give 3 correct examples of Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi from Kenya. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Practise Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi in clear steps

What this means
In this part you learn to practise Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi in clear steps. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: practise Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi in clear steps.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kuandika: Andika sentensi 3 sahihi kuhusu Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can practise Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi in clear steps. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 4: Apply Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi in one real-life situation this week

What this means
In this part you learn to apply Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi in one real-life situation this week. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: apply Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi in one real-life situation this week.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kusoma: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can apply Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi in one real-life situation this week. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO YA HARAKA

Example 1: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako. (skill: explain what Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi means in simple pupil language)

Example 2: Zungumza na rafiki kwa dakika 1 kuhusu Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi. (skill: give 3 correct examples of Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi from Kenya)

Example 3: Andika sentensi 3 sahihi kuhusu Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi. (skill: practise Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi in clear steps)

Example 4: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako. (skill: apply Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi in one real-life situation this week)

SEHEMU 5: MAZOEZI

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: explain what Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi means in simple pupil language.
3. Practise this skill: give 3 correct examples of Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi from Kenya.
4. Practise this skill: practise Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi in clear steps.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA NYUMBANI

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 5 learner study Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. Know what Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: explain what Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi means in simple pupil language.
5. Be able to: give 3 correct examples of Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi from Kenya.

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
